SELECT C.ID , C.COURSE_NAME , TO_CHAR(C.START_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS START_DATE , TO_CHAR(C.END_DATED, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS END_DATED , C."NO" , (SELECT LISTAGG(U.NAME, ', ') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY U.NAME) FROM COURSE_TUTOR CT INNER JOIN "USER" U ON U.ID = CT.TUTOR_ID WHERE CT.COURSE_ID = C.ID) AS NAME , CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM COURSE_TUTOR CT3 WHERE CT3.COURSE_ID = C.ID AND CT3.TUTOR_ID = #{loginId}) THEN 'TUTOR' WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM COURSE_STUDENT CS3 WHERE CS3.COURSE_ID = C.ID AND CS3.USER_ID = #{loginId}) THEN 'STUDENT' END AS MY_RELATION FROM COURSE C WHERE C.DEL_YN = 'N'
AND C.ID IN (SELECT CS.COURSE_ID FROM COURSE_STUDENT CS WHERE CS.USER_ID = #{userId} UNION SELECT CT2.COURSE_ID FROM COURSE_TUTOR CT2 WHERE CT2.TUTOR_ID = #{userId})
ORDER BY C.START_DATE DESC, C.ID DESC

SELECT C.ID , C.COURSE_NAME , TO_CHAR(C.START_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS START_DATE , TO_CHAR(C.END_DATED, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS END_DATED , C."NO" , (SELECT LISTAGG(U.NAME, ', ') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY U.NAME) FROM COURSE_TUTOR CT INNER JOIN "USER" U ON U.ID = CT.TUTOR_ID WHERE CT.COURSE_ID = C.ID) AS NAME FROM COURSE C WHERE C.ID = #{_parameter} AND C.DEL_YN = 'N'

SELECT C."NO" , C.COURSE_NAME , TO_CHAR (START_DATE,'YYYY-MM-DD') AS START_DATE , TO_CHAR(END_DATED, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS END_DATED , C.ID FROM COURSE C -- 요청한 강의(courseId)를 로그인 사용자가 수강 중일 때만 조회 (여러 강의를 들어도 하나만 나옴) WHERE C.ID = #{courseId} AND C.DEL_YN = 'N' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM COURSE_STUDENT CS WHERE CS.COURSE_ID = C.ID AND CS.USER_ID = #{userId})

SELECT U.NAME , u.BASE_ROLE , u.CRT_DT , u.DEL_YN , u.GITHUB_URL , u.ID , u.LOGIN_BLOCK_DATE , u.MDFY_DT , u.PWD , u.PWD_CHANGE_DT , u.PWD_FAIL_CNT FROM "USER" u WHERE DEL_YN = 'N' AND U.BASE_ROLE =(SELECT R.ROLE_ID FROM "ROLE" r WHERE R.ROLE_ID = 'ROLE_STUDENT')

SELECT CH.CONTENT , CH.COURSE_ID , TO_CHAR(CH.CRT_DT,'YYYY-MM-DD') AS CRT_DT , TO_CHAR(CH.END_DATE,'YYYY-MM-DD') AS END_DATE , CH.ID , TO_CHAR(CH.MDFY_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS MDFY_DT , CH.SUBJECT , CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM COURSE_HOMEWORK_REPLY CHR WHERE CHR.HOMEWORK_ID = CH.ID AND CHR.COURSE_STUDENT_ID = #{userId} AND CHR.DEL_YN = 'N') THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS SUBMITTED_YN , (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CHR2.COURSE_STUDENT_ID) FROM COURSE_HOMEWORK_REPLY CHR2 WHERE CHR2.HOMEWORK_ID = CH.ID AND CHR2.DEL_YN = 'N' AND CHR2.COURSE_STUDENT_ID IN (SELECT CS.USER_ID FROM COURSE_STUDENT CS WHERE CS.COURSE_ID = CH.COURSE_ID)) AS SUBMITTED_COUNT , (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM COURSE_STUDENT CS2 WHERE CS2.COURSE_ID = CH.COURSE_ID) AS STUDENT_COUNT FROM COURSE_HOMEWORK CH WHERE CH.COURSE_ID IN (SELECT C.ID FROM COURSE C WHERE C.ID = #{courseId}) AND CH.DEL_YN = 'N'

SELECT CH.CONTENT , CH.COURSE_ID , TO_CHAR(CRT_DT,'YYYY-MM-DD') AS CRT_DT , TO_CHAR(END_DATE,'YYYY-MM-DD') AS END_DATE , CH.ID , TO_CHAR(MDFY_DT,'YYYY-MM-DD') AS MDFY_DT , CH.SUBJECT FROM COURSE_HOMEWORK CH WHERE CH.COURSE_ID = #{courseId} AND CH.ID = #{homeworkId} AND CH.DEL_YN = 'N'

SELECT CH.ID AS HOMEWORK_ID , CH.COURSE_ID , CH.SUBJECT , CH.CONTENT , TO_CHAR(CH.CRT_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS CRT_DT , TO_CHAR(CH.MDFY_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS MDFY_DT , TO_CHAR(CH.END_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS END_DATE , CHR.ID AS REPLY_ID , CHR.CONTENT AS REPLY_CONTENT , TO_CHAR(CHR.CRT_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS REPLY_CRT_DT , TO_CHAR(CHR.MDFY_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS REPLY_MDFY_DT , CHR.DEL_YN AS REPLY_DEL_YN , CHR.COURSE_STUDENT_ID AS COURSE_STUDENT_ID , U.ID AS USER_ID , U.NAME , U.BASE_ROLE FROM COURSE_HOMEWORK CH LEFT JOIN COURSE_HOMEWORK_REPLY CHR ON CHR.HOMEWORK_ID = CH.ID AND CHR.DEL_YN = 'N' LEFT JOIN "USER" U ON U.ID = CHR.COURSE_STUDENT_ID WHERE CH.COURSE_ID = #{courseId} AND CH.ID = #{homeworkId} AND CH.DEL_YN = 'N' ORDER BY CHR.CRT_DT DESC

SELECT ID , "NO" , COURSE_NAME , TO_CHAR(START_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS START_DATE , TO_CHAR(END_DATED, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS END_DATED FROM COURSE WHERE DEL_YN = 'N'

AND TRUNC(START_DATE) = TO_DATE(#{startDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD')

SELECT DISTINCT TO_CHAR(TRUNC(TT.DATETIME), 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS CLASS_DAY FROM COURSE_TIME_TABLE TT INNER JOIN COURSE C ON C.ID = TT.COURSE_ID WHERE TT.COURSE_ID = #{courseId} AND C.DEL_YN = 'N' AND (TRUNC(TT.DATETIME) < TO_DATE(#{startDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') OR TRUNC(TT.DATETIME) > TO_DATE(#{endDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) ORDER BY CLASS_DAY

mapper.sql: SELECT DISTINCT TRUNC(TT.DATETIME) AS CLASS_DAY FROM COURSE_TIME_TABLE TT INNER JOIN COURSE C ON C.ID = TT.COURSE_ID WHERE TT.COURSE_ID = #{courseId} AND TRUNC(TT.DATETIME) BETWEEN TRUNC(C.START_DATE) AND TRUNC(C.END_DATED)
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM () D WHERE D.CLASS_DAY = TRUNC(SYSDATE)

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM COURSE_STUDENT CS WHERE CS.COURSE_ID = #{courseId}) AS STUDENT_COUNT , T.PRESENT_COUNT , T.LATE_COUNT , T.ABSENT_COUNT FROM (SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN A.ATTEND_STATUS = 'Y' THEN 1 END) AS PRESENT_COUNT , COUNT(CASE WHEN A.ATTEND_STATUS = 'L' THEN 1 END) AS LATE_COUNT , COUNT(CASE WHEN A.ATTEND_STATUS = 'N' THEN 1 END) AS ABSENT_COUNT FROM ATTENDANCE A WHERE A.COURSE_ID = #{courseId} AND A.LGN_DT >= TRUNC(SYSDATE) AND A.LGN_DT < TRUNC(SYSDATE) + 1 AND A.USER_ID IN (SELECT CS2.USER_ID FROM COURSE_STUDENT CS2 WHERE CS2.COURSE_ID = #{courseId})) T
SELECT COUNT(*) AS TOTAL_CLASS_DAYS , COUNT(CASE WHEN D.CLASS_DAY < TRUNC(SYSDATE) THEN 1 END) AS PASSED_CLASS_DAYS FROM () D
